title: Power BI sample reports, refreshed with modern visual defaults
author: DataZoe

content.text: Microsoft has refreshed its Power BI sample reports with modern visual defaults, stronger semantic models, mobile-optimized layouts, and newer authoring features to help creators build clearer, more effective reports.
